arxiv-2112-13715.description: Abstract In this supplementary material, we present additional experimental details about dataset descriptions, implementation details in Sec. 1 . In Sec. 2 , we show more experimental analyses on existing Spatio-temporal models, comparison with filters on 2D/3D pose estimation, analysis of additional metrics, comparison with learnable RefineNet, and smoothness on synthetic data.

arxiv-2402-01840.title: Ruitenburg’s Theorem mechanized and contextualized
arxiv-2402-01840.creator: Tadeusz Litak
arxiv-2402-01840.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tadeusz Litak. In 1984, Wim Ruitenburg published a surprising result about periodic sequences in intuitionistic propositional calculus (IPC). The property established by Ruitenburg naturally generalizes local finiteness (intuitionistic logic is not locally finite, even in a single variable). However, one of the two main goals of this note is to illustrate that most “natural” non-classical logics failing local finiteness also do not enjoy the periodic sequence property; IPC is quite unique in separating these properties.

arxiv-2407-21609.title: Ironing the Graphs: Toward a Correct Geometric Analysis of Large-Scale Graphs
arxiv-2407-21609.creator: Saloua Naama, Kavé Salamatian, Francesco Bronzino
arxiv-2407-21609.description: Abstract . Graph embedding approaches attempt to project graphs into geometric entities, i.e. , manifolds. At its core, the idea is that the geometric properties of the projected manifolds are helpful in the inference of graph properties. However, the choice of the embedding manifold is critical and, if incorrectly performed, can lead to misleading interpretations due to incorrect geometric inference.

arxiv-2412-10962.title: The Non-Local Dual Phase Lag Model of Heat Conduction in a Silicon Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor
arxiv-2412-10962.creator: Sharif A. Sulaiman, Zahra Shomali
arxiv-2412-10962.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sharif A. Sulaiman, Zahra Shomali. As the transistors and consequently the chips are getting smaller, the accurate investigation of heat transport at micro/nanoscale, becomes an important issue of concern. This is due to an increase in the energy consumption and the leakage currents as a result of the miniaturization which requires taking care of the thermal behavior to make sure that the device is working in the threshold temperature regime.

arxiv-2509-00540.title: FedThief: Harming Others to Benefit Oneself in Self-Centered Federated Learning
arxiv-2509-00540.creator: Xiangyu Zhang, Mang Ye
arxiv-2509-00540.description: Abstract In federated learning, participants’ uploaded model updates cannot be directly verified, leaving the system vulnerable to malicious attacks. Existing attack strategies have adversaries upload tampered model updates to degrade the global model’s performance. However, attackers also degrade their own private models, gaining no advantage.

pmc-11630597.title: Cost effectiveness of empagliflozin in adult patients with chronic kidney disease in the Netherlands
pmc-11630597.creator: Bart Slob, Tanja Fens, Maaike Weersma, Maarten Postma, Cornelis Boersma, Lisa de Jong, Larry Allan Weinrauch, Larry Allan Weinrauch, Larry Allan Weinrauch
pmc-11630597.description: AimThe recent EMPA-KIDNEY trial showed evidence for preventing disease progression in adult patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) treated with empagliflozin. It is however yet unknown if use of empagliflozin is cost effective in the Netherlands. We aimed to evaluate the cost effectiveness of empagliflozin in adult patients with CKD in the Netherlands.

pmc-12999613.title: Elevated Driving Pressure in Pressure-Controlled Ventilation: An Independent Risk Factor for Adverse Outcomes in Mechanically Ventilated Neonates
pmc-12999613.creator: ShaoCong Zheng, Ya Sun, YuanYi Dai, XueJiao Miao, Shan He
pmc-12999613.description: BackgroundDriving pressure (DP) has recently gained attention as a meaningful variable in lung-protective ventilation, particularly in studies of adult acute respiratory distress syndrome. Its role in neonates, particularly regarding bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD), is poorly defined.MethodsThis single-center retrospective study included 145 neonates who received invasive conventional mechanical ventilation (CMV) for ≥ 72 h between January 1, 2020 and December 31, 2024.

pmc-13096812.title: Sequence patterns in RNA replication via the virtual circular genome mechanism
pmc-13096812.creator: Paul G Higgs
pmc-13096812.description: We ask whether functional RNA sequences could be stably copied nonenzymatically at the time of the origin of life. We show that random sequence mixtures spontaneously reduce to short overlapping sequence sets that have been called virtual circular genomes (VCGs). VCG patterns can be classified as irreducible sets of words.

pmc-13195528.description: gularly sized lesions on the skin and mucous membranes. These malformations are characterized by slow-flow patterns. From a histological perspective, venous malformations are characterized by the presence of large, tortuous vessels. These conditions may manifest sporadically or within familial clusters. Mucocutaneous venous malformations (VMCM) are genetically transmitted and account for 1% of venous malformations.

pmc-13248390.title: Generalized joint hypermobility and functional recovery after THA for unilateral Hartofilakidis type C developmental dysplasia of the hip: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13248390.creator: Yuhang Wang, Zhi Li, Xingshi Yuan, Yuxin Xia, Ming Jiao, Guoyuan Li, Xifu Shang
pmc-13248390.description: BackgroundGeneralized joint hypermobility (GJH) is common in developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) and may affect recovery after total hip arthroplasty (THA) for Hartofilakidis type C, but its impact on the trajectory of postoperative functional recovery in this severe subgroup has not been clearly characterized.

pmc-13321684.title: Severe anemia as a risk factor in Japanese patients with ovarian cancer receiving olaparib: a retrospective study
pmc-13321684.creator: Kenta Yamaoka, Manabu Kume, Ayako Matsumoto, Masaki Hirabatake, Nobutaka Hayashi, Tadashi Shimizu, Takuya Aoki, Nobuyuki Muroi
pmc-13321684.description: BackgroundOvarian cancer is often diagnosed at an advanced stage, and recurrence after initial platinum-based chemotherapy remains a major challenge. Olaparib, a poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitor, is an essential maintenance therapy, particularly for patients with homologous recombination deficiency, with proven efficacy. However, hematologic toxicity—especially anemia—is common and frequently leads to dose reductions or treatment interruptions.
